Zed Section titled “Zed” Zed supports MCP servers when using its AI capabilities. It can use the Astro Docs MCP server to access documentation while performing coding tasks. Complete the following steps in order. First, Open ~/.config/zed/settings.json in your editor. Second, Add the following configuration to your Zed MCP settings: MCP Configuration { "context_servers" : { "Astro docs" : { "settings" : {}, "enabled" : true , "url" : " https://mcp.docs.astro.build/mcp " } } } Finally, Save the configuration.
